disclaimer: Context only — an AI reading of the radar's own deterministic output, not a signal. It feeds no score or allocation, can be wrong or overconfident, and every claim cites the radar evidence it is based on. Graded against the tape over time; treat as odds, not a forecast.

assessments.rationale: Real activity is meaningfully ahead of price, with a divergence z of 2.82 and fused acceleration of 1.428 [P2][P3]. The signal spans six sources: congressional buying, lobbying, material 8-K events, and grant opportunities are positive, but federal contracts are negative and news flow is neutral [P3]. Persistence is plausible because several independent channels are rising and news acceleration is positive, with all measured news being unscheduled, but the emerging lifecycle and lack of historical persistence evidence limit confidence [P1][P5]. Continuity is weak: 60-day relative strength is -20.83% with a -2.201 z-score, so price has not confirmed the activity [P4]. The appropriate stance is MONITOR until contracts or price begin validating the otherwise broad activity signal [P3][P4].
assessments.rationale_zh: 实际活动明显领先价格，背离值为2.82，综合加速度为1.428 [P2][P3]。六类来源中，国会净买入、游说活动、重大8-K事件和联邦拨款机会均为正，但联邦合同为负，新闻流量中性 [P3]。多个独立渠道同时改善，且新闻加速度为正、全部属于非预定新闻，说明趋势可能延续；但该主题仍处早期，材料也没有提供长期持续性的证据 [P1][P5]。过去60天相对大盘表现为-20.83%，价格尚未确认实际活动，因此应继续观察，等待合同或价格转强 [P3][P4]。
assessments.rationale_plain: Government-related buying, lobbying, corporate disclosures and grant opportunities are picking up across the space industry, although federal contract activity remains soft and overall news volume is not yet increasing. Prices have lagged the market sharply over the past 60 days, so investors have not confirmed the improving activity. The setup is promising but early; watch for stronger contract awards or sustained price improvement before acting.
assessments.rationale_plain_zh: 航天行业的政府相关买入、游说活动、公司重大披露和拨款机会正在增加，但联邦合同活动仍然偏弱，新闻总量也尚未明显上升。过去60天相关公司股价明显落后大盘，说明投资者还没有认可这些改善。前景值得关注，但目前仍偏早，宜等待合同增长或价格持续转强后再行动。
assessments.dissent: The strongest bullish case is that four independent activity channels are positive while activity leads price by a large margin; the severe relative-price weakness could therefore represent an unusually early entry point rather than a broken narrative [P2][P3][P4].

falsifiable_check.confirm: Confirm the thesis if subsequent readings retain positive multi-source acceleration, federal contracts improve from their current negative reading, and 60-day relative performance recovers from -20.83% [P3][P4].
falsifiable_check.disconfirm: Disconfirm it if the currently positive congressional, lobbying, material-event, or grant signals fade while federal contracts remain negative, especially if relative performance continues deteriorating [P3][P4].

assessments.name: Space Economy

assessments.rationale: Real activity is strong and broad: government contracts and congressional net buying are both elevated, with additional positive contributions from material 8-K events and lobbying across four sources; fused acceleration is 2.242 [P3]. Durability is credible but not yet proven because the signal is multi-source while the lifecycle remains forming, lobbying is only marginally positive, and there is no supporting news leg [P1][P3][P5]. Continuity is favorable for entry: activity leads price by a 2.123 z-score while 60-day relative strength is still negative, indicating that the covered group has not yet reflected the signal [P2][P4][P6]. Verdict: ENTER with medium confidence, as the activity-price gap offers upside but persistence still needs confirmation [P1][P2].
assessments.rationale_zh: 现实活动信号较强且来源广泛：政府合同和国会议员净买入明显上升，重大8-K事件和游说活动也有正向贡献，四个来源的综合加速度为2.242 [P3]。持续性具备一定可信度，但尚未得到充分验证，因为当前仍处于形成阶段，游说增幅很弱，而且没有新闻面的配合 [P1][P3][P5]。价格尚未跟上活动信号：活动相对价格领先2.123个标准差，而过去60天的相对表现仍为负，因此判断为ENTER，但置信度为中等 [P2][P4][P6]。
assessments.rationale_plain: Government contracting and congressional buying are picking up strongly across the covered communications companies, while corporate disclosures add support and lobbying activity is only edging higher. Share prices have lagged the broader market over the past 60 days, so the improving real-world activity does not yet appear fully reflected. This supports taking a position now, but only with moderate conviction because the trend is still emerging and has no reinforcing news momentum.
assessments.rationale_plain_zh: 相关通信公司的政府合同和国会议员买入活动明显增加，企业重大事项披露也提供了支持，但游说活动仅小幅上升。过去60天，这些公司的股价落后于大盘，说明现实活动的改善尚未充分反映在价格中。可以考虑现在介入，但应保持适度仓位，因为这一趋势仍处于早期，也没有新闻热度进一步推动。
assessments.dissent: The strongest countercase is that the apparent surge is concentrated in government contracts and congressional buying, while lobbying is nearly flat, material-event support is modest, the setup is only forming, and no news leg exists; the divergence could therefore be temporary rather than durable [P1][P3][P5].

falsifiable_check.confirm: Confirm if the next observation retains positive contributions from multiple sources—especially government contracts and congressional net buying—while relative performance improves from its current negative 60-day reading [P3][P4].
falsifiable_check.disconfirm: Disconfirm if government-contract or congressional-buying signals fall back toward neutral without stronger lobbying or material-event activity, particularly if relative performance remains negative and no news leg develops [P3][P4][P5].

assessments.name: Communication Services (Equal-Weight)

assessments.rationale: Real activity is moderately strong: lobbying and government contracts are about one standard deviation above baseline, material 8-K events are also positive, and the four-source fused acceleration is 1.461 [P3]. Durability is plausible but unproven because the signal spans four sources, yet congressional net buying is negative, there is no supporting news leg, and the setup is only forming [P1][P3][P5]. Continuity is mixed: activity leads price by a modest 0.351 z, while 60-day relative strength is positive at 2.15% but lacks a clear directional confirmation [P2][P4]. MONITOR is appropriate until persistence or stronger price confirmation emerges.
assessments.rationale_zh: 真实活动信号中等偏强：游说和政府合同活动均较基准高约一个标准差，重大8-K事件也为正，四类来源的综合加速度达到1.461 [P3]。其持续性有一定基础，但尚未得到验证，因为国会议员净买入为负、没有新闻支持，而且当前形态仍处于形成阶段 [P1][P3][P5]。价格确认较为有限：活动仅温和领先价格，过去60天相对大盘上涨2.15%，但尚无明确方向 [P2][P4]。因此目前更适合观察，等待活动延续或价格进一步确认。
assessments.rationale_plain: Government contracting, corporate lobbying and material company disclosures are all picking up, suggesting that business activity around consumer-staples companies is improving. However, congressional buying is weak, there is no supporting news momentum, and the group has outperformed the market by only about 2.2% over 60 days without a clear trend. Keep it on the watchlist until the activity persists or prices respond more decisively.
assessments.rationale_plain_zh: 政府合同、企业游说和重大公司披露都在增加，显示消费必需品企业周边的经营活动正在改善。不过，国会议员买入偏弱，也没有新闻热度配合；该板块过去60天仅比大盘多涨约2.2%，趋势仍不明确。现阶段宜继续观察，等待这些活动持续，或价格出现更明确的跟进。
assessments.dissent: The strongest bullish counterargument is that activity is already accelerating across four sources while price has responded only modestly, leaving room for a catch-up move [P2][P3][P4].

falsifiable_check.confirm: Confirm the thesis if the next observations retain positive contributions from government contracts, lobbying and material events, while 60-day relative strength develops a clearly positive direction [P3][P4].
falsifiable_check.disconfirm: Disconfirm it if fused acceleration fades toward neutral or negative, positive source contributions narrow materially, or relative strength turns negative before price catches up [P2][P3][P4].

assessments.name: Consumer Staples (Equal-Weight)

assessments.rationale: Real activity is weak across all three measured sources: Congress net buying (-0.887), lobbying (-2.61), and material 8-K events (-0.432), despite a modest positive fused acceleration reading [P3]. Durability is poor because the lifecycle is fading and there is no supporting news leg [P1][P5]. Continuity is especially weak: relative price strength is positive over 60 days while activity trails price sharply, producing a -2.732 divergence [P2][P4]. The narrative therefore appears to be running on price momentum rather than improving underlying activity [P1][P2][P3].
assessments.rationale_zh: 三类现实活动指标均偏弱：国会净买入、游说升温和重大8-K事件都为负，尽管综合加速度略为正 [P3]。持续性较差，因为趋势已进入衰退阶段，且没有新闻流支持 [P1][P5]。过去60天价格相对市场走强，但现实活动明显落后于价格，显示叙事更多依赖价格动能，而非基本活动改善 [P2][P4]。
assessments.rationale_plain: Insurers and brokers have outperformed the market over the past 60 days, but congressional buying, lobbying activity, and material corporate events are all weakening. With no supportive news flow and signs that the pickup is fading, prices appear to have moved ahead of the real-world activity. Avoid chasing the theme unless several activity measures turn upward together.
assessments.rationale_plain_zh: 保险公司和经纪商过去60天跑赢大盘，但国会买入、游说活动和重大公司事件都在减弱。当前也没有新闻流提供支持，而且此前的升温迹象正在消退，说明价格可能已经领先于现实活动。暂时不宜追高，除非多项活动指标同步转强。
assessments.dissent: The strongest counterargument is that the theme has positive 60-day relative strength and modest positive combined acceleration across three sources, which could mean activity is near a turn rather than continuing to fade [P3][P4].

falsifiable_check.confirm: Confirm AVOID if the next update still shows negative readings across lobbying, congressional buying, and material events while relative price strength remains positive, indicating price continues to outrun activity [P2][P3][P4].
falsifiable_check.disconfirm: Disconfirm AVOID if at least two of the three activity sources turn positive and the fading classification reverses, ideally with a supporting news leg [P1][P3][P5].

assessments.name: Insurance & Brokers

assessments.rationale: Real activity is mixed rather than broadly strong: lobbying and federal grant opportunities are improving, but material 8-K events are sharply weak, congressional buying is negative, contracts are neutral, and news flow is soft [P3]. Near-term momentum offers some support—fused acceleration is 0.722 [P3], while news velocity is 3.0 with 0.25 acceleration and entirely unscheduled coverage [P5]—but the overall radar is fading [P1]. Price has already outperformed the market by 12.68% over 60 days [P4], while the activity-price divergence is negative at -1.585 [P2], indicating that market enthusiasm is ahead of observable activity rather than being led by it. The appropriate stance is therefore to wait for broader, persistent improvement before entering.
assessments.rationale_zh: 现实活动信号喜忧参半：游说活动和联邦资助机会有所改善，但重大8-K事件明显疲弱，国会议员净买入为负，政府合同没有增长，新闻流也偏弱[P3]。短期动能略有改善，综合加速度为0.722[P3]，新闻速度为3.0、加速度为0.25，且全部为非预定新闻[P5]；但整体状态仍在衰退[P1]。过去60天价格相对市场上涨12.68%[P4]，而现实活动相对价格的背离为-1.585[P2]，说明价格热度已经领先于可观察到的实际活动，因此更适合等待更广泛且持续的改善后再介入。
assessments.rationale_plain: Corporate lobbying and federal funding opportunities are improving, and recent news activity has accelerated modestly. However, major company disclosures, congressional buying, government contracts, and overall news flow do not show a similarly strong expansion. Prices have already outperformed the market by about 13% over two months, so investors should wait for wider and more persistent real-world improvement before buying.
assessments.rationale_plain_zh: 企业游说和联邦资助机会正在增加，近期新闻活动也略有加快。但重大公司披露、国会议员买入、政府合同和整体新闻量尚未同步增强。相关公司过去两个月的表现已领先大盘约13%，因此更适合等待现实活动出现更广泛、更持久的改善后再考虑买入。
assessments.dissent: The strongest bullish counterargument is that the positive fused acceleration, improving lobbying and grant signals [P3], accelerating unscheduled news [P5], and strong relative price performance [P4] could mark an early transition that the fading classification has not yet captured [P1].

falsifiable_check.confirm: Upgrade toward ENTER if the next observation shows activity moving ahead of price, with the divergence turning positive [P2], while improvement expands beyond lobbying and grants into material events, contracts, congressional buying, or news flow [P3].
falsifiable_check.disconfirm: Move toward AVOID if fused acceleration turns negative, lobbying or grant momentum fades, and material-event or news signals remain weak [P3], especially while the fading state persists [P1] or relative price strength reverses [P4].

assessments.name: AI Software & Platforms

assessments.rationale: Real activity is weak across most inputs: congressional net buying (-1.116), material 8-K events (-0.516), and the regulatory pipeline (-0.717) are negative, while lobbying is only marginally positive (0.09) [P3]. Although fused acceleration is positive at 0.702 across four sources [P3], the theme is already classified as fading with NEGATIVE_DIVERGENCE [P1], and activity trails price materially (divergence z=-1.413) [P2]. Price has nevertheless outperformed SPY by 8.11% over 60 days [P4], suggesting the narrative is running ahead of observable activity; the absence of a news leg offers no additional reinforcement [P5].
assessments.rationale_zh: 现实活动信号整体偏弱：国会议员净买入、重大8-K事件和监管推进指标均为负，游说活动仅略有改善[P3]。尽管四类来源合成后的加速度为正[P3]，该主题已处于减弱阶段且现实活动明显落后于价格[P1][P2]。过去60天价格相对大盘上涨8.11%[P4]，但没有新闻推动作为补充支撑[P5]，因此当前叙事更像是价格走在基本活动之前。
assessments.rationale_plain: 与存储芯片相关的现实活动大多在减弱：政策相关买入、企业重大事项和监管推进都偏弱，只有游说活动略有改善。与此同时，相关股票过去60天跑赢大盘约8%，说明价格已经走在这些活动之前，而且没有新的新闻推动提供支撑。现阶段更适合回避，等待现实活动出现更广泛、持续的改善。
assessments.rationale_plain_zh: 与存储芯片相关的现实活动大多在减弱：政策相关买入、企业重大事项和监管推进都偏弱，只有游说活动略有改善。与此同时，相关股票过去60天跑赢大盘约8%，说明价格已经走在现实活动之前，而且没有新的新闻推动提供支撑。现阶段更适合回避，等待多类现实活动出现持续改善。
assessments.dissent: The strongest contrary case is that fused acceleration is already positive across all four monitored source categories [P3]; if this is an early inflection, the current price strength [P4] may be anticipating activity that has not yet appeared in the slower individual indicators.

falsifiable_check.confirm: Confirm the AVOID call if the next update still shows negative activity-price divergence, a fading state, and at least three of the four source signals at or below zero while price remains relatively strong [P1][P2][P3][P4].
falsifiable_check.disconfirm: Disconfirm it if the divergence turns positive and improvement becomes visible in multiple individual sources—not merely the fused measure—while relative price strength remains positive [P2][P3][P4].

assessments.name: Memory, HBM & Storage

rotation.summary: Leadership is rotating toward confirmed Non-AI Tech/Hardware and Financials, with early activity-led setups in Space Economy, Communication Services, and Consumer Staples; AI, health-care growth, and power/infrastructure themes are fading or already confirmed down.
rotation.summary_zh: 领导力正转向已获真实活动确认的非AI科技硬件与金融，同时太空经济、通信服务和必需消费呈现活动领先价格的早期机会；AI、医疗成长及电力基础设施主题正在衰退或已确认下行。
accumulate: Space Economy — POSITIVE_DIVERGENCE, emerging: activity leads price in an early-stage setup.
Communication Services (Equal-Weight) — POSITIVE_DIVERGENCE, forming: activity leads price and leadership is beginning to form.
Consumer Staples (Equal-Weight) — POSITIVE_DIVERGENCE, forming: activity leads price and supports an early defensive rotation.
Non-AI Tech & Hardware — CONFIRMED_UP, confirming: real activity and price jointly confirm leadership.
Financials (Equal-Weight) — CONFIRMED_UP, confirming: real activity and price jointly confirm leadership.
reduce: Insurance & Brokers — NEGATIVE_DIVERGENCE, fading: price is running ahead of weakening activity.
AI Software & Platforms — NEGATIVE_DIVERGENCE, fading: price lacks activity confirmation.
Memory, HBM & Storage — NEGATIVE_DIVERGENCE, fading: activity is not validating price leadership.
GLP-1 & Obesity — NEGATIVE_DIVERGENCE, fading: price is ahead of activity.
Health Care (Equal-Weight) — NEGATIVE_DIVERGENCE, fading: activity is weakening relative to price.
AI Semiconductors — NEGATIVE_DIVERGENCE, fading: price leadership is not confirmed by activity.

Uranium & Nuclear Fuel; Critical Minerals & Rare Earths; Data-Center Power & Cooling; Nuclear & SMR Power; Power & Grid Buildout — CONFIRMED_DOWN, fading: both activity and price confirm deterioration.
AI Neoclouds & HPC Hosting; Semiconductor Equipment; Quantum Computing — CONFIRMED_DOWN, fading: both activity and price confirm deterioration.
Utilities (Equal-Weight) and Silver Miners — CONFIRMED_DOWN, fading: weakness is confirmed by activity and price.
watch: POSITIVE_DIVERGENCE themes moving to CONFIRMED_UP would validate broader leadership beyond the current two confirmed leaders.
Non-AI Tech & Hardware or Financials slipping from CONFIRMED_UP into NEGATIVE_DIVERGENCE or CONFIRMED_DOWN would weaken the rotation thesis.
AI Semiconductors, AI Software, Memory/HBM, or power/grid themes recovering from fading states to POSITIVE_DIVERGENCE would signal renewed AI-complex leadership.
QUIET themes developing POSITIVE_DIVERGENCE—especially Industrials, Reshoring, Defense, Energy, or discretionary groups—would indicate rotation broadening.
Consumer Staples losing POSITIVE_DIVERGENCE while cyclical sectors strengthen would reverse the tentative defensive component of the read.
